sources.title: Introducing Egret-1
sources.snippet: The Egret-1 family of NNPs comprises three pretrained models built for different use cases: Egret-1. Egret-1, a general-purpose model for bioorganic simulation, was trained on 951,005 structures of 19,228 unique organic molecules containing the elements C, H, N, O, F, P, S, Cl, Br, and I.
